name: engineering-concepts
description: Built-in catalog of software engineering concepts (principles, patterns, practices, architectures) as data: short pointer records to each concept's official source, never copied definitions, each tagged by concern, kind, stage and reversibility with its counterweights and conflicts. A lookup script and skills find an entry by name, alias, id or tag and load a topic or entry into the session.

source_bar.title: Source bar
source_bar.description: Which catalog records lookups return: official (every record with an official source) or official-plus-confirming (only records that also list a confirming source). docs/conventions/engineering-concepts.yaml overrides this.

exclude.title: Excluded concepts
exclude.description: Comma-separated concept ids or topic names that lookups drop. Unioned with every exclude list in docs/conventions/engineering-concepts.yaml and its .local.yaml.
